params.scenes_source: v13 unified (JADES DR5 w/ CSV photo_z, both fields + DESI calibration galaxies)
params.z_source: VELA stamp native redshift (z=1/scale-1, range 1-4), selected with z_source > z_lens+0.1

params.einstein_mass_msun: projected mass within theta_E (M_sun): M_E = c^2/(4G) (D_d D_s / D_ds) theta_E^2, Planck18
